'''Fulmine''' is an [[NPC]] in {{Location|Ragunna City}}. He is the manager of the Wutherim Film Studio and a member of the [[Pioneer Association]].

Fulmine's [[Forte]] is called Celluloid Chronicle or Film Memory, allowing him to turn events into strands of film-shaped hair. With the help of his partner, [[C-MOSS]], he can project these captured moments. 

==Quests and Events==
{{Quests and Events}}

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Fulmine:''' Here's to a world of discoveries and wonders! Welcome to the Pioneer Association of [[Ragunna]].
:{{DIcon}} About Pioneer Association
:'''Fulmine:''' The Pioneer Association of Ragunna operates under our visual production division, the Wutherium Film Studio.
:'''Fulmine:''' We're dedicated to capturing reality through our lenses, showing not just the devastation of disasters but also the transformations they bring.
:'''Fulmine:''' Our mission here is to capture and preserve these changes to offer people a new way to see the world.
:'''Fulmine:''' Whenever you need it, [[C-MOSS]] and I will be ready to capture every important moment for you.
:'''Fulmine:''' I'm confident that we'll create many  treasured memories here in Ragunna.

:{{DIcon}} About yourself
:'''Fulmine:''' Pleasure to meet you! I am Fulmine, the head of the Wutherium Film Studio. We are the visual production division of the Pioneer Association. 
:'''Fulmine:''' Umm... Did you happen to pick up any film on your way here?
::{{DIcon}} What kind of film?
:'''Fulmine:''' Well, like the ones on my head.
:'''Fulmine:''' My Resonance power, "Film Memory," lets me turn memorable moments and dreams into strands of film-shaped hair.
:'''Fulmine:''' Nifty, right? Sometimes even lost ideas resurface in the film!
:'''Fulmine:''' But lately, all those late nights have started taking a toll... I'm losing hair, and along with it, some of my precious film.
:'''Fulmine:''' Some of it is a bit... personal. If anyone ever saw them, I'd just die of embarrassment—ahhhh!
:'''Fulmine:''' So, {{Rover}}, if you come across any of my films lying around, could you please return them to me?
:'''Fulmine:''' ...And um, promise me you  won't peek, okay?
::{{DIcon}} I promise.
::{{DIcon}} No promises!
:{{DIcon}} Goodbye
:'''Fulmine:''' Here's to a world of discoveries and wonders! Until we meet again!
----
;One time Interaction at the Resonance Nexus in Ragunna City
:'''Matheus:''' Nonsense! Absolutely nonsense!
:'''Nathan:''' Huh!? You are overreacting...
:{{DIcon}} What happened?
:'''Nathan:''' This Acolyte here was telling me stories about the Order of the Deep in Ragunna, like the Final Tide and Flood of the End Times prophesied by the Sentinel Imperator.
:'''Nathan:''' I actually think some of these ideas align with terms from current Tacetite theories. 
:'''Nathan:''' For example, you've likely seen the [[Etheric Sea]] in Huanglong, haven't you? It's a unique sky phenomenon associated with the appearance of the Tacet Fields and Tacent Discords.
:'''Nathan:''' Now, we've proven this waveworn phenomenon is a manifestation of the Lament—a pattern we can observe and study and —
:'''Matheus:''' Nonsense! The tides suspended in the sky are clear evidence of the Sentinel's prophesy!
:'''Matheus:''' Only by gathering under the protection of Imperator and the Order, by constantly ascending and connecting, can we find the path to salvation.
:'''Nathan:''' I understand why you'd hold that view, but —
:'''Matheus:''' By Imperator! Perhaps I really should send you to the Order Penitentiary immediately. You should be on the Pilgrim's Sail, repenting for your sins!
:{{DIcon}} Maybe you should stop here...
:'''Nathan:''' Alright, alright...
:'''Matheus:''' Ragunna will not tolerate insults to our faith!
:'''Tao:''' Mr. Fulmine!
:'''Fulmine:''' What is it? Calm down. Take your time.
:'''Tao:''' Nathan had a major disagreement with an Acolyte named Matheus. Now he threatens to contact the Order Penitentiary to have Nathan expelled...
:'''Fulmine:''' What? How did it get to this?
:'''Tao:''' Heard it was about the prophecies by Imperator. Nathan raised some unconventional interpretations and the two started to argue.
:'''Fulmine:''' Nathan's new in the city. You can't expect him to catch on the depths of Ragunna's history...
:'''Fulmine:''' Let me handle this... Hello, am I speaking to Brother Matheus?
:'''Matheus:''' Yes, that's me. May I ask to whom am I speaking?
:'''Fulmine:''' This is Fulmine from the Pioneer Association. You may have heard of me.
:'''Fulmine:''' I heard the Order plans to produce a documentary about the Tidal Sancturary to spread Imperator's blessings through a new channel?
:'''Matheus:''' Yes... the Order is indeed preparing for that.
:'''Fulmine:''' I believe the Pioneer Association may help with this project. If you're interested, why not come to our studio for a detailed discussion when you're available?
:'''Matheus:''' Well... but...
:'''Fulmine:''' Also, I think in the interests of cooperation, and of the Order, we could move past the unpleasant exchange you've had?
:'''Matheus:''' ...I see. Thank you for your contribution to the Order, Mr. Fulmine.
:'''Tao:''' He hung up...
:'''Fulmine:''' I'll take care of this from here. Don't worry.
{{Dialogue End}}
